liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Henry Spelman, Concilia (1639) I 619, printed from his own manuscript
liebermann.notes: Spelman's Concilia prints from his own manuscript parts of ECf retr (Prol.–12, 12,5, 13,1, 15, 20–20,5, 23, 32); at p. 219 he takes 32b,3–8 only from Ld.

entries.text_de: Spelman, Concil. M. Brit. I 619 druckt aus eigenem Codex: ECf retr, Prol.—12. 12, 5. 13, 1. 15. 20—20, 5. 23. 32. (Dagegen p. 219 nimmt er 32b, 3—8 nur aus Ld.)
entries.text_en: Spelman, Concil. M. Brit. I 619, prints from his own codex: ECf retr, Prol.—12. 12, 5. 13, 1. 15. 20—20, 5. 23. 32. (On the other hand, on p. 219 he takes 32b, 3—8 only from Ld.)

transcription.doubts: 'ECf retr' in roman. There is a small raised mark after '20, 5' (looks like a stray dot or apostrophe); omitted.
